control.description-key: Drag and drop files to upload them as Note attachments on the current record. Lists, downloads and deletes existing attachments.

property.name: hostField
property.description-key: Any single line text column. The control is placed on it but never changes its value.

property.name: allowedExtensions
property.description-key: Optional. Comma separated extensions, for example .pdf,.docx,.png. Leave empty to allow every type the environment allows.

property.name: maxFileSizeMB
property.description-key: Optional. Leave empty to allow whatever the environment allows (System Settings > Email > Maximum file size). Set it only to make the limit lower for this form.

property.name: maxFilesPerDrop
property.description-key: How many files can be added in one go.

property.name: noteSubject
property.description-key: Title given to each Note. Leave empty to use the file name.

property.name: showExistingFiles
property.description-key: List the attachments already on the record, with download.

property.name: allowDelete
property.description-key: Show a delete button on existing attachments. Dataverse security still applies.

property.name: showThumbnails
property.description-key: Show a small picture for image attachments. Each image is downloaded once to draw it.
